title: Austin Young and the banjoist Gaia at the dance hall
summary: Russell praises Austin Young; Verrett recalls a band after he left with Gaia, who stayed on one chord.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: I used to like your cousin Austin Young was playing on bass.
One of the best I ever heard. Is that right?
Trombone. Good tone, good rhythm, good harmony and you know the chorus.
Yeah, I know he's a good man. Both of his brothers were good. The sport was real good too. Good musician. Now they worked in the foreign dance after I came out. They worked there for many years.
I remember when Austin worked there. I guess his brother too I heard.
Yeah, after we left there they worked there and this piano player kills us. Gaia the bandjure player. You know Gaia.
Oh yeah, how was he? Was he pretty good musician?

Bandjure or Gaia? Oh yeah. Well it was alright. You know during that time like I said it was the type of musicians that most of them trumpet players would hide because they'd stay in one place you see. Nothing sensational there. No, no. They'd stay right there. Gaia them guys stay right there. They would wait for a long time with a lot of those trumpet players around here that prefer them guys but being such a few of them they couldn't supply all the bands and therefore they had to come back and get the guy that they didn't want you see.
